rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns with ByteDance's creator-economy focus, where Weiru works on product marketing for platforms like CapCut that empower non-traditional builders. While Charlie brings deep expertise in developer tools and mobile platforms (Expo, React Native), Weiru offers perspective on how creator-focused products reach and onboard new audiences at scale—complementary angles on democratizing software creation.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Weiru @Creative Community — you're both working on how AI and accessible tools are expanding who can create and ship products, from different sides (developer infrastructure vs. creator platforms).
